info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Prospect Campaign Design Design-spec
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Design API enables users to create and manage design specifications for marketing prospect campaigns. This API allows businesses to define the visual and functional elements of their campaigns, ensuring they align with branding and marketing goals. Typical consumers include marketing teams and developers looking to automate campaign design processes. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline their campaign creation workflow, ensuring faster deployment and better-targeted marketing efforts.

post.summary: Create a new prospect campaign design.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new prospect campaign design. The design will be associated with a specific campaign and can include various elements tailored to attract prospective customers. Ensure all required fields are provided in the request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new design for a prospect campaign through the marketing module. The design should adhere to the specified schema, ensuring all necessary information is included for successful processing.

201.description: Successfully created a new design resource.
